name: Select Customer for Invoice On Popover Open
purpose: Popover open: clears the customer filter field, puts the cursor in it and refreshes the customer portal.

name: Select Customer for Invoice On Popover Close
purpose: Popover close: clears the customer filter field, puts the cursor in it and refreshes the customer portal.

name: Select Customer for Invoice: Filter
purpose: Filter-as-you-type for the customer picker: keeps the cursor selection, refreshes the customer portal and restores the selection.

name: InvoiceItem Amount OnObjectExit Trigger
purpose: OnObjectExit on invoice line amount: rounds the amount to 2 decimals and, when a unit price exists and unitPrice*qty rounds to a different amount, recomputes unitPrice = amount / qty (7 decimals), as QBO does.
writes:
InvoiceItem::amount#6 (step 4, current record)
InvoiceItem::unitPrice#7 (step 13, current record)
open_question: Rule matches the QBO interface; quantity defaults to 1.

name: Select Customer for Invoice
purpose: Sets the invoice's customer to the customer selected in the popover and closes it.

name: Add Customer From Invoice
purpose: Add customer from the invoice: if the typed filter text is empty, goes to the new-customer name field; otherwise clears the invoice customer, commits (breaking the link) and sets the new related customer's display name to the filter text.
writes:
Invoice::id_Customer#7 (step 4, current record)
Invoice_Customer::displayName#9 (step 7, current record)
open_question: Creates a related Invoice_Customer record by writing displayName through the relationship (step 7).

name: Invoice OnCommit Trigger
purpose: Invoice OnCommit trigger: flags the invoice for sending to QBO (qbo_send), recalculates subtotal and taxable subtotal from the lines, total (subtotal + tax + shipping) and balance (total - paid).
reads:
InvoiceItem::summaryTotalAmount#14
InvoiceItem::summaryTotalAmountTaxable#13
Invoice::subtotal#33
Invoice::totalTax#30
Invoice::shipAmt#41
Invoice::totalAmt#25
Invoice::totalPaid#58
writes:
Invoice::qbo_send#3 (step 3, current record)
Invoice::subtotal#33 (step 7, current record)
Invoice::taxableSubtotal#34 (step 8, current record)
Invoice::totalAmt#25 (step 18, current record)
Invoice::balance#26 (step 20, current record)
open_question: Tax calculation (steps 11-16) is disabled because QBO calculates tax. The trigger writes durable totals: this logic must be a server rule in the target.

name: New Invoice for ( id_Customer )
purpose: Creates a new invoice for a customer id: goes to the desktop invoice layout, creates a record and sets the customer.
writes:
Invoice: new record (New Record/Request step 6)
Invoice::id_Customer#7 (step 7, new record)
open_question: Tablet and phone branches are disabled (steps 8-23) and point at layouts that no longer exist.

name: Go To Chart
purpose: Goes to the invoice chart layout and sorts invoices by period.

name: Open Payments Portal Ob Invoice
purpose: Turns on layout object animation and moves to the PaymentsPortal object.

name: Delete Invoice
purpose: Commits and deletes the invoice by calling Delete Invoice (FmId) with the invoice id.
writes: delete: Invoice (via karbon_LedgerLink.fmp12/scripts/634, step 5, record with id = Invoice::id)
open_question: Delete effect is in LedgerLink script 634.
